items.title: 6.2.1 Selection of terms in A.P. (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein A.P. ka formula \(a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\) aaya tha. Aaj hum do kaam seekhenge: pehla, jab sawal mein terms ka jama ya product diya ho to unhein samajhdari se kaise chunein (selection of terms); doosra, A.P. ki kuch khoobiyan. Phir kitab ki chaar misalein qadam ba qadam hal karenge.

items: (i) Three consecutive terms of an A.P. can be chosen as \(a - d, a, a + d\) or \(a, a + d, a + 2d\).
(ii) Four consecutive terms of an A.P. may be written as \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) or \(a, a + d, a + 2d, a + 3d\).
(iii) The last four consecutive terms, if \(\ell\) is the last term, can be written as \(\ell - 3d, \ell - 2d, \ell - d, \ell\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Terms ko beech se dono taraf barabar (symmetric) kyun chunte hain? Kyun ke jab sawal mein terms ka jama diya ho to \(d\) khud ba khud cancel ho jata hai:
\[(a - d) + a + (a + d) = 3a\]
\[(a - 3d) + (a - d) + (a + d) + (a + 3d) = 4a\]
Yani ek hi equation se \(a\) foran mil jata hai, aur doosri shart (jaise product) se \(d\). Agar \(a, a + d, a + 2d\) lete to jama \(3a + 3d\) aata aur do unknowns ulajh jate.
Dhyan dein: \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) mein lagataar terms ka farq \(2d\) hai, \(d\) nahin. Yani is A.P. ka common difference \(2d\) hai. Chaar terms mein beech ki koi akeli term nahin hoti, is liye beech \(a - d\) aur \(a + d\) ke darmiyan hai.
Jab sawal aakhri term ke baare mein ho to \(\ell - 3d, \ell - 2d, \ell - d, \ell\) chunein; \(\ell\) ko "el" parhte hain aur yeh last term ka nishan hai.

If each term of an A.P. is increased or decreased, multiplied or divided by the same non-zero number, then the resulting sequence is also an A.P., i.e., if \(a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, \ldots, a_{n}, \ldots\) are in A.P., then

items: (i) \(a_{1} \pm k, a_{2} \pm k, \ldots, a_{n} \pm k, \ldots\) are also in A.P. with common difference \(d\).
(ii) \(ka_{1}, ka_{2}, \ldots, ka_{n}, \ldots\) are in A.P. with common difference \(kd\).
(iii) \(\frac{a_{1}}{k}, \frac{a_{2}}{k}, \ldots, \frac{a_{n}}{k}, \ldots\) are in A.P. with common difference \(\frac{d}{k}\).

(iv) Term-by-term addition or subtraction of two arithmetic progressions is also an A.P., i.e., if \(a_{1}, a_{2}, a_{3}, \ldots, a_{n}, \ldots\) and \(b_{1}, b_{2}, b_{3}, \ldots, b_{n}, \ldots\) are in A.P., then \(a_{1} \pm b_{1}, a_{2} \pm b_{2}, a_{3} \pm b_{3}, \ldots\) are also in A.P.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh baatein sach kyun hain? Har jagah sirf \(a_{n} - a_{n-1} = d\) istemal karein:
(i) \((a_{n} + k) - (a_{n-1} + k) = a_{n} - a_{n-1} = d\). Socheiye sab bachon ki height mein 5 cm ki ek jaisi edi (heel) laga di jaye: sab lambe ho gaye, magar aapas ka farq wahi raha.
(ii) \(ka_{n} - ka_{n-1} = k(a_{n} - a_{n-1}) = kd\): farq bhi \(k\) guna ho jata hai.
(iii) \(\frac{a_{n}}{k} - \frac{a_{n-1}}{k} = \frac{d}{k}\). Yahan \(k \ne 0\) zaroori hai, kyun ke zero se divide karna maana hai.
(iv) Do A.P.s ke common differences \(d_{1}\) aur \(d_{2}\) hon to term ba term jama ya tafreeq wali A.P. ka common difference \(d_{1} \pm d_{2}\) hoga.
Misaal: \(1, 3, 5, \ldots\) ko 2 se multiply karein to \(2, 6, 10, \ldots\) jis ka \(d = 4 = 2 \times 2\).
Kitab (iii) ka jumla thoda bikhra hua chhapti hai ("A.P are in A.P. common difference"); matlab wahi hai jo upar likha hai.
Ab kitab ki misalein. Har misaal mein pehle dekhenge ke kya diya hai aur kya chahiye, phir formula chunenge.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.problem: Find the general term and the eleventh term of the A.P. whose first term and common difference are 2 and \(-3\) respectively. Also write its first four terms.
steps:
Given: \(a_{1} = 2\), \(d = -3\).
To find: general term \(a_{n}\), gyarhvi (eleventh) term \(a_{11}\), aur pehli chaar terms.
Method: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke humare paas pehli term aur common difference dono hain. To \(a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\) mein rakh kar \(n\) ka ek rule bana lete hain; phir jo term chahiye us ki position rakh dein.

Step 1: General term
\[a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\]
\[a_{n} = 2 + (n-1)(-3)\]
\[= 2 - 3n + 3\]
\[a_{n} = 5 - 3n \quad \text{...(i)}\]
Kyun: \((n - 1)(-3)\) kholne par \(n \times (-3) = -3n\) aur \((-1) \times (-3) = +3\) aata hai; minus aur minus ka zarb plus hota hai. Phir \(2 + 3 = 5\).
Dhyan dein: bohat se students yahan \(-3n - 3\) likh dete hain; sign ka khayal rakhein.

Step 2: Gyarhvi term, (i) mein \(n = 11\)
\[a_{11} = 5 - 3(11)\]
\[= 5 - 33 = -28\]
Kyun: general term mil gaya to har term seedhi position rakhne se milti hai, gin gin kar likhne ki zaroorat nahin.

Step 3: Pehli chaar terms, (i) mein \(n = 2, 3, 4\)
\[a_{2} = 5 - 3(2) = -1\]
\[a_{3} = 5 - 3(3) = -4\]
\[a_{4} = 5 - 3(4) = -7\]
Kyun: \(a_{1} = 2\) pehle se diya hua hai, is liye pehli chaar terms \(2, -1, -4, -7\) hain.

Tasdeeq:
(i) se \(a_{1} = 5 - 3 = 2\): diya hua jawab wapas aaya.
Terms \(2, -1, -4, -7\) har baar 3 kam ho rahi hain, jo \(d = -3\) ke mutabiq hai.
\(a_{11} = a_{1} + 10d = 2 - 30 = -28\). Sahi.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: If the 5th term of an A.P. is 13 and the 17th term is 49, find \(a_{n}\) and \(a_{13}\).
steps:
Given: \(a_{5} = 13\) aur \(a_{17} = 49\).
To find: \(a_{n}\) aur \(a_{13}\).
Method: yahan na \(a_{1}\) diya hai na \(d\); yeh do unknowns hain. Do maloom terms ko formula mein likhein to do equations ban jati hain, aur do equations se do unknowns nikal aate hain (simultaneous equations).

Step 1: 5th term se equation
\[a_{5} = a_{1} + (5-1)d\]
\[13 = a_{1} + 4d \quad \text{...(i)}\]
Kyun: general term mein \(n = 5\) rakha.

Step 2: 17th term se equation
\[a_{17} = a_{1} + (17-1)d\]
\[49 = a_{1} + 16d\]
\[49 = (a_{1} + 4d) + 12d\]
\[49 = 13 + 12d \quad \text{by (i)}\]
Kyun: kitab ne \(16d\) ko \(4d + 12d\) mein toda taa ke \(a_{1} + 4d\) ban jaye, jo (i) ke mutabiq 13 hai. Yeh doosri equation mein se pehli minus karne ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: 5th se 17th term tak 12 qadam hain, is liye farq \(49 - 13 = 36 = 12d\). Yeh shortcut yaad rakhiye.

Step 4: \(a_{13}\) aur \(a_{n}\)
\[a_{13} = 1 + (13-1)3 = 37\]
\[a_{n} = 1 + (n-1)3 = 3n - 2\]
Kyun: ab \(a_{1} = 1\) aur \(d = 3\) dono maloom hain, to general term mukammal ho gaya. \(1 + 3n - 3 = 3n - 2\).

Tasdeeq:
\(a_{5} = 3(5) - 2 = 13\) aur \(a_{17} = 3(17) - 2 = 49\). Dono di hui terms wapas aa gayin, is liye jawab durust hai.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem: Find the number of terms in the A.P. if \(a_{1} = 3\), \(d = 7\) and \(a_{n} = 59\).
steps:
Given: \(a_{1} = 3\), \(d = 7\), \(a_{n} = 59\) (aakhri term).
To find: \(n\), yani A.P. mein kitni terms hain.
Method: aakhri term hi \(n\)th term hai. To formula mein maloom values rakh kar \(n\) ke liye equation hal karenge.

Step 1: Values rakhein
\[59 = 3 + (n-1) \times 7\]
Kyun: \(a_{n} = 59\), \(a_{1} = 3\), \(d = 7\). Ab sirf \(n\) unknown hai.

Step 2: \(n\) nikaalein
\[56 = (n-1) \times 7\]
\[n - 1 = 8\]
\[n = 9\]
Kyun: dono taraf se 3 minus kiya, phir 7 se divide. \(n\) terms ki ginti hai, is liye natural number hona chahiye; 9 bilkul theek hai. Agar kabhi fraction aaye to samajh lein ke woh number A.P. ki term hi nahin.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.problem: If \(a_{n-2} = 3n - 11\), find the \(n\)th term of the sequence.
steps:
Given: \(a_{n-2} = 3n - 11\).
To find: \(a_{n}\).
Method: yeh rule position \(n - 2\) wali term deta hai. Humein position \(n\) chahiye. Agar har jagah \(n\) ki jagah \(n + 2\) rakh dein to subscript \((n + 2) - 2 = n\) ban jayega.

Step 1: \(n\) ki jagah \(n + 2\)
\[a_{n+2-2} = 3(n+2) - 11\]
Kyun: rule har position ke liye sach hai, is liye \(n\) ko \(n + 2\) se badalna jaiz hai. Lekin badalna dono taraf hai: subscript mein bhi aur right side par bhi.

Step 2: Simplify
\[a_{n} = 3n + 6 - 11\]
\[a_{n} = 3n - 5\]
Kyun: subscript mein \(n + 2 - 2 = n\), aur \(3(n + 2) = 3n + 6\).

Tasdeeq:
\(a_{n} = 3n - 5\) se \(a_{n-2} = 3(n-2) - 5 = 3n - 6 - 5 = 3n - 11\). Diya hua rule wapas aa gaya.

blocks.text: Chaaron misalon ko saath rakh kar dekhiye: har ek mein asal kaam yeh pehchanna tha ke formula \(a_{n} = a_{1} + (n-1)d\) ki chaar cheezon mein se kaun si maloom hai aur kaun si gum. Example 2 mein \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) maloom the, to seedha general term ban gaya. Example 3 mein do terms maloom thin, to do equations banin. Example 4 mein \(n\) gum tha, to equation \(n\) ke liye hal hui. Example 5 mein formula kisi aur position ke liye diya tha, to substitution se position badli. Exercise 6.2 ke sawal bhi inhi chaar namoonon par hain; sawal parhte hi namoona pehchaniye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. Teen terms A.P. mein hon aur jama 21 ho to beech wali term kya hai? (\(3a = 21\), to \(a = 7\).)
2. \(4, 7, 10, \ldots\) ki har term mein 5 jama karein to naya \(d\) kya hoga? (Wahi 3.)
3. Agar \(a_{n+1} = 2n + 7\) ho to \(a_{n}\)? (\(n\) ki jagah \(n - 1\): \(a_{n} = 2n + 5\).)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin.) Teen numbers A.P. mein hain, jama 15 aur product 105. Numbers nikaalein.
Terms \(a - d, a, a + d\) lein. Jama: \(3a = 15\), to \(a = 5\).
Product: \((5 - d)(5)(5 + d) = 105\)
\[5(25 - d^{2}) = 105\]
\[25 - d^{2} = 21 \Rightarrow d = \pm 2\]
Numbers: \(3, 5, 7\) (ya \(d = -2\) se \(7, 5, 3\)). Tasdeeq: \(3 + 5 + 7 = 15\), \(3 \times 5 \times 7 = 105\).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Teen terms: \(a - d, a, a + d\); chaar terms: \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) (common difference \(2d\)); aakhri chaar: \(\ell - 3d, \ell - 2d, \ell - d, \ell\).
2. Har term mein ek hi non-zero number jama, tafreeq, zarb ya taqseem karne se A.P. A.P. hi rehti hai.
3. Do A.P.s ka term ba term jama ya farq bhi A.P. hai.
4. Do maloom terms se \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) ki do equations banti hain.
5. Terms ki ginti ke liye aakhri term ko \(a_{n}\) maan kar \(n\) nikaalein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) ka common difference \(d\) samajhna: woh \(2d\) hai.
2. Sign ki ghalti: \((n - 1)(-3) = -3n + 3\) hai, \(-3n - 3\) nahin.
3. "Pehli chaar terms" likhte waqt \(a_{1}\) ko bhool jana.
4. Example 5 jaise sawal mein \(n\) ki jagah \(n - 2\) rakh dena: subscript ko \(n\) banana hai, is liye \(n + 2\) rakhte hain.
